description: Per-channel planning priors and rules derived from the Freemans 2026 brief plus the June 2022-April 2023 MMM deck. These rules are for prototype reasoning, not final investment advice.

objective.budget_guardrail: Every pound needs to be spent with care; plans should show efficiency rationale and test risk separately.

channel_rules.planning_role: Intent-led demand capture; the largest and most efficient channel in the mix, and the primary driver of checkout starts.
channel_rules.mmm_note: MMM shows Search as consistently the most efficient demand-capture channel, with strong incremental return at current spend but diminishing returns once brand and top generic terms are fully covered.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Keep always-on brand and generic coverage year-round; add tactical upweights around Black Friday, Christmas and the new-season launch moments.

channel_rules.planning_role: Demand capture and retargeting with strong creative flexibility across fashion, home and electricals.
channel_rules.mmm_note: MMM shows Meta delivering solid demand-capture and retargeting performance, with response flattening faster than broadcast channels once category audience saturation is reached.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Maintain always-on prospecting and retargeting; avoid over-weighting the final week of any peak without separating the two audiences.

channel_rules.planning_role: Commission-based distribution through cashback and voucher-code partners; efficient but capacity-limited by the active publisher network.
channel_rules.mmm_note: MMM and commission-based affiliate evidence agree performance is efficient but capacity-limited by the size of the active affiliate/cashback network, with limited headroom to scale materially without recruiting new publishers.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Keep a stable always-on commission base; add incremental publisher activity and featured placements around Black Friday and January Sale.

channel_rules.planning_role: Broad reach and frequency at efficient cost per listener-hour; a stable brand-presence channel rather than a growth lever.
channel_rules.mmm_note: MMM shows Radio delivering steady incremental reach at a stable cost per order, with limited headroom to scale materially beyond current levels before diminishing returns set in.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Hold a steady weekly presence; add modest weight around January Sale and the Black Friday/Christmas peak rather than concentrating spend narrowly.

channel_rules.planning_role: Incremental video reach and consideration; controlled growth testing rather than a proven default allocation.
channel_rules.mmm_note: YouTube investment was historically small, so MMM evidence remains lower-confidence than Search or Meta - early signs are reasonable but not yet enough history for a confident optimal share.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Use as measured test support around new-season launches and Black Friday/Christmas, rather than a large default allocation.

channel_rules.planning_role: Visual discovery and inspiration for fashion and home ranges; brief-led strategic layer, not an MMM-proven channel.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Pinterest is not present in the MMM optimal channel table, so it should be treated as a brief-led strategic/measurement layer rather than a proven recommendation.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Concentrate around new-season launch and gifting moments (Mother's Day, Christmas) rather than spreading thinly across all months.

brief_test_criteria.label: Hits the sample brief target frame
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Generated plan should balance to the supplied 2026 budget and show whether forecast new customer orders clear 1,000,000.

brief_test_criteria.label: Uses MMM priors where available
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Channel rationales should cite the client MMM extract and identify any channel where brief demand exceeds MMM evidence.

brief_test_criteria.label: Responds to named brief priorities
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Plan QA should flag priority areas requiring explicit treatment: seasonal trading peaks, Multi-Category growth, World Cup context, brand-trust creative platform, channel role clarity and testing.

brief_test_criteria.label: Separates evidence gaps from confident recommendations
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Pinterest, YouTube and new partnership opportunities should be tagged as tests or measurement-led choices rather than treated as proven MMM recommendations.
